Plugin.Name: rclone-jobs
Plugin.Overview: Scheduled rclone and rsync job manager for Unraid 7 with a dry-run gate, mount guard, deletion limits, live SSE progress monitoring, and native Unraid notifications (bell, email, Telegram).
Plugin.Description:
[b]rclone-jobs[/b] is a dedicated Unraid 7 plugin designed for safe, automated file synchronisation and offsite backups.
[b]Key Features:[/b] [list] [*] [b]Dry-Run Safety Gate:[/b] Newly created or modified jobs remain locked in Dry-Run mode until you inspect the preview log and intentionally unlock live execution. [*] [b]Mount Guard & Array Verification:[/b] Prevents sync runs if source or destination paths are unmounted or missing. [*] [b]Max-Delete Protection:[/b] Enforces configurable limits on file deletions to prevent accidental data loss from misconfigured remote paths. [*] [b]Native Unraid Notifications:[/b] Integrates seamlessly with Unraid's notification system (webGui bell, email, Telegram, Discord, Pushover). [*] [b]Zero Background Daemons:[/b] Integrates cleanly with Unraid's Dillon cron; zero memory overhead when idle. [*] [b]Real-Time SSE Live Progress:[/b] Watch rclone transfers live via Server-Sent Events with automatic fallback. [*] [b]Zero-Conf Rclone Reuse:[/b] Automatically pairs with existing credentials in /boot/config/plugins/rclone/.rclone.conf. [/list]
[b]Requirements:[/b] Requires Unraid 7.0.0 or higher.
